_doc: SPEC-100 manual event feed for capabilities/backtest_accumulation.py — desk-verified accumulation cases sourced from memory (GOAL-close-gaps.md G1 / SPEC-76). `signal_date` is the desk's best-effort reconstruction of the FIRST accumulation signal, not a precisely on-chain-dated timestamp (date_confidence flags this) — the historical-replay feed (source_historical_events) is the precise measurement once wallet+contract pairs are enumerable. This file exists so the §9 backtest runs even before wide enumeration is affordable; it does NOT by itself clear the n>=10 gate.
